Icm.//TrustedUserName: The ICM user calls act as, sent as the X-ICM-TrustedUserName header. Set it with: dotnet user-secrets set "Icm:TrustedUserName" 'the-username'

Auth.//TokenUrl: Optional. Set only for a non-Keycloak server or an unusual path; it overrides BaseUrl and Realm entirely.

//Mode: query = the Service Request search below. buspass = submit the BusPass section through the INT-316 workflow, then read the created SR back (a hand-run integration test - it CREATES a record in the target ICM). contact = search contacts by id, name, SIN, PHN, birth date etc. (read-only). case = read a case by row id or find it by case number / key player, and print it with the people on it (read-only). prospect = read the prospects on a service request, one by row id, or search them (read-only) - or, with Prospect:Create:Enabled=true, CREATE one directly and read the service request's prospects back. describe = fetch a resource's OpenAPI document from ICM and save it (read-only).

Contact.//: The search for contact mode. Every criterion identifies a person, so none is committed: pass them on the command line (--Contact:LastName=... --Contact:BirthDate=1950-01-31) or keep them in the user-secret store. Criteria: Id, PersonId, IntegrationId, BcServicesCardDid (quote it - base64 may contain + / =), Sin (nine digits), Phn, FirstName, MiddleName, LastName, BirthDate (yyyy-MM-dd), Email, CellPhone, HomePhone, WorkPhone, MessagePhone. All that are set must match.
Contact.//NameMatch: How the name criteria are compared, always ignoring case: Exact, StartsWith or Contains.
Contact.//ViewMode: Siebel visibility. MEASURED on SIT1 2026-09-17: the default already sees contacts, unlike service requests. Try Organization if a known contact is not found.
Contact.//ShowValues: false reports which fields came back filled, not what they hold - enough to check the search and mapping without people's details in scrollback.

Case.//: case mode. Id reads one case by its row id (the case_key); otherwise the criteria below are searched, ANDed. The three key-player criteria take what a contact search prints: ContactId its Id, PersonId its PersonId, IntegrationId its IntegrationId. Pass them on the command line, e.g. --Case:CaseNumber=1-11077140770.
Case.//ViewMode: Null is the library's default, Manager. MEASURED on SIT2 2026-09-24: Sales Rep (ICM's default), Organization and Personal hide the reference case; Manager, Group, Sub-Organization and Catalog see it.
Case.//ShowValues: SIT1 and SIT2 hold test data, so values print by default. Set false against anything else.

Prospect.//: prospect mode. ServiceRequestId reads the prospects on that SR (the child path, MEASURED to work); Id reads one row on the standalone path Prospects/SRProspects; otherwise ProspectiveContactUId / Source are searched on the standalone path. Pass them on the command line, e.g. --Prospect:ServiceRequestId=1-53CJXK6.
Prospect.//ViewMode: Null is the library's default, Organization - the mode every prospect read so far was made under. Sales Rep (ICM's default) hides service requests and so, presumably, their prospects.
Prospect.//ShowValues: SIT1 and SIT2 hold test data, so values print by default. Set false against anything else.

Create.//: Enabled=true CREATES a prospect row in the target ICM (PUT Prospects/SRProspects with Id NULL and Service Request Id in the body - ICM's documented shape, MEASURED 2026-09-29), then reads the SR's prospects back to see whether the new row is listed. FirstName, LastName, BirthDate and Gender are ICM's required fields. Synthetic values: the address is the BC legislature. Set ServiceRequestId on the command line to an SR you own.
Create.//Gender: M/F picklist: Man/Boy, Woman/Girl, Non-Binary, Unknown.
Create.//Source: Source, Source Name and Source Type are not in ICM's field list for a prospect (ADO 8249); the rows the workflow files show Source Name SIEBEL_EAI / Source Type Manual Entry, set by ICM.

Activity.//: activity mode. ServiceRequestId reads the activity plans and activities on that SR - the events on it (both child paths MEASURED); Id reads one activity; otherwise CaseId / PlanName / Status / Type are searched on data/Activities/Activities. ShowValues=true prints every field instead of one line per activity.

Create.//: Enabled=true CREATES an activity on the target ICM (PUT Activities/Activities with Id NULL and Activity SR Id - ICM's documented shape, MEASURED 2026-09-29: 1-53MU3Y4 on SR 1-53MU3X7). The defaults are the workflow's step 01 of Bus Pass - New Intake, field for field. Set ServiceRequestId on the command line to an SR you own.
Create.Description: Validate if the SIN is present for the contact, if not then update SIN; validate address; and promote prospect if applicable.
Create.//ActivityPlanId: A plan instance row id to hang the step off. None can be created through the REST API (the Template picklist refuses Bus Pass - New Intake), so a direct activity has no plan.

SrContact.//: srcontact mode. ServiceRequestId reads the contacts on that SR with their relationship (its ICMContact child). ContactId, when set, first LINKS that existing contact to the SR (PUT …/ICMContact with SR Relationship / SSA Primary Field - ICM's 'PUT Contact to Service Request' guidance in the names SIT2 honours, MEASURED 2026-09-29): a primary Key player link also sets the SR's Primary Contact Id and header names, as the workflow does for a matched applicant. Pass both on the command line.

Direct.//: direct mode CREATES a bus pass service request in the target ICM with the Prospect:Create row nested in it (no workflow), waits SettleSeconds, then reads the new SR, its SRProspects, Activities and ActivityPlan back beside the reference SR's. The SR values are what the workflow filed for SR 1-53CJXK6 (MEASURED 2026-09-29).

ServiceRequest.//Indigenous: The workflow's SRs read TBD, but TBD is not a value the write picklist accepts (SBL-DAT-00225) - leave it null.

Direct.//IncludeProspect: MEASURED 2026-09-29: the nested prospect is refused by ICM's integration object (its user key needs Service Request Id, and then Siebel tries to ASSOCIATE an existing prospect through an association list the component lacks - SBL-DAT-00276). Off until ICM changes the IO; the SR itself creates fine.
Direct.//ReferenceServiceRequestId: 1-53CJXO6 is the workflow's clean, unmatched Application of 2026-09-14 - the closest analogue to a direct create with no Primary Contact Id.

Describe.//Resource: The two path segments after data/, e.g. ICMContact/ICMContact or ServiceRequest/ServiceRequest.
Describe.//OutputFile: Where to write the document, e.g. ../IcmApi/docs/integration/Contact_OpenApi.json. Null prints it instead.

BusPass.//: Synthetic on purpose: the SIN is the canonical test number, the address is the BC legislature. A buspass run creates a real SR in the target ICM.

Mailing.//: Leave empty for a One Address submission; fill in for Multiple Addresses.

Query.//ServiceRequestKey: An ICM row id to read on its own after the search. This is the Row # from Siebel's About Record dialog, not the SR # in the list - the SR # is not a queryable field on this business component. Null skips the step.
Query.//SearchSpec: e.g. [Status] = "Open". Note [SR Number] does NOT work - ICM rejects it as an invalid field.
Query.//Fields: ICM's live field names. The committed default deliberately selects non-personal fields only - SIT records carry real-looking names, addresses and phone numbers, and 'full' output would put them in terminal scrollback. Set to [] to request every field when a run genuinely needs it (e.g. hunting unmodelled fields with --Output=raw).
Query.//ChildLinks: Child business components to link in the response.
Query.//ChildCollection: A child business component to read raw after the read-by-key step, e.g. SRProspects (the applicant rows a Bus Pass SR carries). Null skips it.
Query.//ViewMode: Siebel visibility. ICM's default, 'Sales Rep', returns only records the trusted user owns - which hides most of the data. MEASURED: 'Sales Rep' and 'Manager' cannot see SR 1-53A894E; 'Organization' can. 'All' is rejected outright (SBL-EAI-50243).
Query.//ExcludeEmptyFields: true keeps the dump readable; set false to see every field ICM defines.

//Output: full = every non-null mapped field per record. summary = one line each. raw = the untouched JSON ICM returned, then the mapped view - use this to see fields the model does not cover.
